finalText:
It builds clean now. Two real bugs, both from the bundler bump:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. That was throwing and killing the build.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated an unset backoff flag as invalid instead of "off." The new config loader leaves it `undefined` rather than `false`, so this also threw.

Fixed both, and the build now exits 0. The rest of the wall of text is just deprecation noise from the bump itself (`Buffer()`, `punycode`, etc.) — not bugs, so I left those alone.
